description: Returns a paginated list of property damage records for the specified project, optionally scoped to a single incident via incident_id. Each property damage includes description, cost impact, responsible company, managed equipment, work activity, and custom fields. By default sorted by descending full_number (incident.number). Supports filtering by responsible company and full-text search.

parameters.name: incident_id
parameters.description: Optional incident ID to scope results. When provided, returns only property damage records belonging to the specified incident. Omit to retrieve property damages across all incidents in the project.

parameters.name: filters[responsible_company_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Vendor ID.
